turns.text: Now, let's talk about how they handled the topic transitions.
turns.zh: 现在，我们来说说他们是怎么处理话题过渡的。

turns.text: Sarah asked, "How's your first week going?" and then immediately made it relatable by sharing her own experience.
turns.zh: Sarah 问：「你第一周过得怎么样？」然后马上分享了自己的经历，让这个话题变得有共鸣。

turns.text: I remember feeling completely lost when I started here.
turns.zh: 我记得我刚来这儿的时候，完全找不着北。

turns.text: This technique of sharing similar experiences is huge for building connections.
turns.zh: 这种分享相似经历的方法，对建立连接特别有用。

turns.text: It made David feel comfortable right away.
turns.zh: 这让 David 一下子就感觉自在了。

turns.text: And notice how they used follow-up questions throughout the conversation.
turns.zh: 还有，注意他们在整个对话中是怎么用追问的。

turns.text: When David mentioned his previous job was stressful, Sarah didn't just say, "Oh, okay." She said, "I totally get that." And connected it to her own experience.
turns.zh: 当 David 提到他上一份工作压力很大时，Sarah 没有只说「哦，好吧。」她说：「我完全懂那种感觉。」然后把它和自己的经历联系了起来。
